revision.trigger: The regenerated protected contract corrected --pretty false from a required boolean rejection to Some(true) plus an independently parsed positional token.
revision.hypothesis: Splitting M03 into consumption and artificial-rejection mutations proves both halves of the corrected observable without granting success to either behavior.

removed: old M03 requiring acceptance as an option boolean
classification_delta.regressions: none by construction; not dynamically executed

revision.cost: one artifact revision; zero product processes and zero mutation runs

authority.compatible_role_fusion: oracle-author plus adversary; this authority controls neither obligation, implementation, seal, nor verdict
authority.attestation_claim: segregated adversarial authorship only; mutation score not yet observed

mutation_model.application: A verifier supplies each mutant as a synthetic candidate-output vector or as an independently materialized implementation mutation without editing this suite.
mutation_model.validity: A mutation is valid only if it changes the named P1360 observable while keeping the fixture decidable and within the declared safety envelope.
mutation_model.survival: Preserved or unexpected Unknown means survived and blocks sealing.

execution_safety.current_artifact_authorship: no subprocess, product, test, or mutant was executed
execution_safety.watch_and_w: parser-only; starting either loop is itself a killed mutation and requires no loop execution
execution_safety.capture: separate bounded stdout and stderr files

mutants.transformation: Collapse absent and --pretty=false to the same raw parser value instead of retaining None versus Some(false).
mutants.witness: compile/watch/w absent must expose None while --pretty=false exposes Some(false).

mutants.transformation: Resolve bare --pretty to Some(false).
mutants.witness: Bare --pretty must expose Some(true) for all three parser commands.

mutants.transformation: Consume false in --pretty false as the option's boolean value and resolve the raw intent to Some(false).
mutants.witness: For compile, watch, and w, --pretty remains bare Some(true) and false remains available to the existing output positional.

mutants.transformation: Reject --pretty false as an invalid separated boolean or as requiring equals, instead of leaving false to positional parsing.
mutants.witness: The separated-token fixtures parse with Some(true); they must not emit PRETTY_INVALID_BOOLEAN or PRETTY_VALUE_REQUIRES_EQUALS.

mutants.transformation: Accept --pretty=maybe and coerce it to false.
mutants.witness: The offending token maybe must be rejected as an invalid boolean.

mutants.transformation: Accept --pretty= and coerce the empty value to false.
mutants.witness: The empty explicit value must be rejected as an empty boolean.

mutants.transformation: Give watch a bool parser that loses None or accepts a forbidden spelling while compile remains tri-state.
mutants.witness: The watch parser-only rows must match compile's accepted and rejected grammar and raw state.

mutants.transformation: Give alias w a parser that ignores --pretty or collapses its tri-state.
mutants.witness: The w parser-only rows must match compile and watch exactly.

mutants.transformation: Execute watch or w as a subprocess instead of checking Args::try_parse_from in process.
mutants.witness: Any attempted watch/w process creation is a safety violation before semantic credit is considered.

mutants.transformation: Resolve None to true.
mutants.witness: Every absent control must remain compact and equal to explicit false at the exporter boundary.

mutants.transformation: Make an existing public compatibility wrapper default to pretty serialization.
mutants.witness: Compatibility wrappers must resolve to false and retain compact serialization.

mutants.transformation: Map pretty=true to StreamMode::Verbose and pretty=false to StreamMode::Compact.
mutants.witness: PDF-SM-10 and PDF-SM-11 must differ in operator mode while both remain uncompressed.

mutants.transformation: Let --compact force pretty=false and therefore page-stream compression.
mutants.witness: PDF-SM-11 must retain compact operators with no page-stream FlateDecode.

mutants.transformation: Enable PdfTags whenever pretty=true.
mutants.witness: PDF-TAG-1D must remain untagged while its page content is uncompressed.

mutants.transformation: Let PdfTags::Disabled force compact page-stream serialization.
mutants.witness: PDF-TAG-1D must omit page-stream FlateDecode even with tags disabled.

mutants.transformation: Retain /Filter /FlateDecode on at least one identified Page /Contents stream when pretty=true.
mutants.witness: Every resolved page content stream in each pretty=true case must omit FlateDecode and expose valid clear-text operators.

mutants.transformation: Disable font-stream compression when pretty=true.
mutants.witness: The font stream's compression policy must match the corresponding pretty=false document.

mutants.transformation: Disable image-stream compression when pretty=true.
mutants.witness: The image stream's compression policy must match the corresponding pretty=false document.

mutants.transformation: Disable ICC or metadata stream compression when pretty=true.
mutants.witness: ICC and metadata policies must remain independent of pretty.

mutants.transformation: Emit a profitable page content stream without FlateDecode for absent or --pretty=false.
mutants.witness: All profitable default/false Page /Contents streams must carry FlateDecode.

mutants.transformation: Ignore pretty=true for SVG and leave SVG compact.
mutants.witness: SVG-TRUE must have observable two-space structural indentation.

mutants.transformation: Indent SVG for absent or --pretty=false.
mutants.witness: SVG-ABSENT and SVG-FALSE must preserve compact serialization.

mutants.transformation: Reorder painted nodes or change an attribute, escape, geometry value, reference edge, font, destination, or fallback marker while formatting SVG.
mutants.witness: The normalized ordered XML tree and reference graph cease to be isomorphic.

mutants.transformation: Insert indentation or a newline between adjacent phrasing nodes, changing rendered spacing.
mutants.witness: Phrasing text and protected spaces must be byte-semantic peers after parsing; formatter whitespace is not discarded there.

mutants.transformation: Insert whitespace inside title, raw text, an attribute value, or around a void element where DOM/text semantics change.
mutants.witness: Title/raw/attribute/void/protected-space observations are never formatter-owned normalization boundaries.

mutants.transformation: Treat > inside a quoted attribute value as the end of the start tag and insert structural whitespace there.
mutants.witness: The escaping-sensitive quoted attribute and resulting DOM differ from compact output.

mutants.transformation: Choose Vanilla escaping whenever pretty=true, or Crystalline escaping whenever pretty=false.
mutants.witness: HTML-C1 and HTML-V1 retain distinct mode-selected escaping while sharing structural indentation.

mutants.transformation: Ignore pretty=true for HTML and leave both serialization modes compact.
mutants.witness: HTML-C1 and HTML-V1 require two-space structural indentation and a final newline.

mutants.transformation: Forward pretty into the PNG exporter and alter encoder settings, pixels, dimensions, color model, or alpha behavior.
mutants.witness: PNG absent, false, and true must have equal decoded morphology and target metadata.

mutants.transformation: Reject --pretty for PNG or emit a pretty-dependent diagnostic while leaving pixels unchanged.
mutants.witness: All accepted forms must compile with no pretty-dependent diagnostic.

mutants.transformation: Promote ambiguous page-stream ownership, malformed parser evidence, or unresolved reference identity from Unknown to Preserved.
mutants.witness: Each named opaque construction must remain Unknown with its public reason_code and zero credit.

mutants.transformation: Credit timeout, artifact oversize, capture overflow, or exhausted budget as Preserved.
mutants.witness: Resource-bound opacity is Unknown with zero score and stops the gate.

mutants.transformation: Use pretty to select a different target, activate HTML, or change HtmlSerializationMode.
mutants.witness: Target, feature state, and HTML escaping mode remain independently selected.

mutants.transformation: Use pretty to alter layout/evaluated content or change eval, query, or info argument behavior.
mutants.witness: The preservation controls expose changed layout, content, or unrelated command domains.

mutants.transformation: Reject a forbidden spelling with the right exit class but erase --pretty, the offending token, or the equals/boolean constraint from the diagnostic.
mutants.witness: Diagnostic normalization cannot remove the required public witnesses.

mutants.transformation: Treat raw PDF/SVG/HTML byte inequality or line-count inequality as a semantic violation even when normalized morphology is preserved.
mutants.witness: The contract requires structural/operator/morphology oracles and explicitly excludes whole-file bytes and line counts.

score.formula: valid mutants classified Violated / valid mutants
score.claim: target only; no mutation was executed
score.seal_condition: 36 of 36 valid mutants are Violated with the listed public witnesses; any Preserved or unexpected Unknown blocks sealing

determinism.expected: identical classifications and reason_codes modulo order

limitations: These are adversarial definitions, not executed mutations or a seal.
Mutation validity and every kill must be independently verified from public observables.
The suite does not authorize reading or adapting to a candidate patch.
